provenance.source: Maximum of saturated raw frames in this library. The sensor is 14-bit, stored as 16-bit in steps of 4, so a clipped frame reaches 65532. Copied from the CAMERA_CEILING_ADU comment in pipelines/stacking/exposure_saturation.py.
Pipeline default: just under the 16-bit maximum of 65535. See measure_saturated_pixel_fraction in pipelines/shared/quality/quality_metrics.py.
Antonov 2026, as cited in pipelines/shared/quality/quality_metrics.py: response turns non-linear above about 60,000 ADU at Gain 0 / Offset 10.
Read off the sensitivity graph published by ZWO. Copied from pipelines/spectroscopy/quantum_efficiency_curves.py.
